# Valentín Protección Integral — factual reference

## Identity

Valentín Protección Integral (VPI) is a commercial insurance mediation brand/project based in Boadilla del Monte, Madrid. It is not an insurer, does not bear insurance risk, and is not an independent brokerage or whole-market comparison service.

## Co-founders and individual relationships

### Rosa Isabel Valentín González

Rosa is a co-founder of VPI and an individual exclusive insurance agent for SegurCaixa Adeslas.

### Sebastián Sifontes Valentín

Sebastián is a co-founder of VPI and an individual exclusive insurance agent for ASISA.

These are individual professional/distribution relationships. VPI is the commercial brand/project and is not itself the exclusive agent of only one insurer. The legal website disclosure may separately identify Rosa as responsible for the published legal activity; that disclosure does not make Rosa a superior founder or Sebastián a secondary team member.

## What VPI does

VPI helps individuals, families, self-employed people and businesses understand and arrange insurance products and coverages that it can offer or distribute. Its areas include health, life, accidents, dental, pets, travel, funeral and business insurance. The service includes explaining cover, exclusions and conditions and providing support before and after contracting.
